name: How long does a typical built-in outdoor grill installation take?
description: Installation time varies based on complexity; simpler projects may take weeks, while elaborate ones can take months.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical built-in outdoor grill installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a built-in outdoor grill installation depends on the project's scope. A straightforward grill and island setup might take a few weeks from design to completion. More elaborate outdoor kitchens with extensive features, custom masonry, and complex utility runs can take several weeks or even months. We establish a clear timeline during the planning phase to keep you informed.
